# Vivek Chaturvedi

> Vivek Chaturvedi is a polymath in Bengaluru, India: an inventor and the founder of the design house Aadivaahan, a self-taught musician, a digital painter, a healer and a coach. He is a former Indian Navy officer and gave the TEDx talk "The Unperformance" at TEDxNMIMSBangalore in 2014. This site, aadivaahan.com, is his personal site.

Several other people share the name Vivek Chaturvedi, including finance executives and journalists. This site is only about the Bengaluru inventor and musician described here.

## The site, in his order

- Healing. Purnam: one-to-one wellbeing work, offered under the name Avimukt, starting from a five-fingertip exercise. Not medical treatment.
- Coaching. Spiral: his practice of "the search for personal integrity", offered one to one. Not medical or psychological treatment.
- Design. Aadivaahan redesigns everyday objects the way a living body works: Footware (footwear built around the toes), Heaven-met (a helmet with its soft layer on the outside), a vibration damper after the redwood tree, and Sundancer, a three-wheeler by aadimoto. Most are at the design or early model stage.
- About. The better part of twelve years in the Indian Navy as an electrical engineering officer; aide-de-camp to the Governor of Karnataka in 1994; studied at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute in the United States; technology strategy and Silicon Valley work; returned to India around 2006. TEDx talk "The Unperformance" (2014): to per-form is to live as per a form. Three short films from 2016.
- Art. Digital paintings, posted from 2010, shown untitled.
- Music. Self-taught on guitar, flutes, cajon, djembe, tabla, didgeridoo, jaw harp, keyboard and voice. Plays his guitar tuned like a tanpura and improvises; nothing is scripted. About fifty music videos on his YouTube channel Aadinaadam.
- The sandbox. Ways to work with him: consult, collaborate, or talk about investing. Write to vivek@aadivaahan.com.
